To ensure a smooth development experience and provide full transparency, we maintain a comprehensive resource detailing known issues and their respective workarounds. This section guides you to this essential information, designed to assist you in effectively navigating any challenges related to our services.

You may access the documentation by visiting the following link: [https://community.mybodas.boschrexroth.com/programming-info](https://community.mybodas.boschrexroth.com/programming-info){.weblink target="_blank"}

On this page, you will find:

- A detailed overview of currently identified issues

- Descriptions of their impact and affected functionalities

- Recommended interim solutions or workarounds

- Status updates and resolution timelines, where applicable

We appreciate your understanding and continued trust. Should you require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our [support team](https://community.mybodas.boschrexroth.com/support-info){.weblink target="_blank"}.
